title: SOC2 evidence daily scratchpad
body:
Quick log / scratchpad for SOC2 evidence collection, vendor reviews, and policy TODOs. Informal notes - not final.

2026-02-27 (morning)
- Daily goals: clear outstanding evidence items for Audit Run A; finish vendor questionnaire for VaultCorp; sync with legal on data retention language.
- Top priority: finalize access-review evidence for SRE on Dedicated infra (JIRA-SOC2-58) - need signed attestation from ops leads.

Evidence collection status (short):
- Access control matrix (served via Confluence page CONFLUENCE-SEC-1122): draft table present, missing confirmations from platform-eng and serving-runtime. Action: ping Liam/Anita by EOD.
- User access review (monthly): last run 2026-01-30. Need export of Okta org-role mappings for Feb/Mar - ticket created (JIRA-OKTA-243). TODO: follow up with Identity team.
- Change management (deploy approvals): collected most PR links; missing prod rollback logs for 2025-12-08 incident. Action: ask release-eng for remediation note.
- Encryption (KMS) evidence: have key rotation schedule doc, missing export of key usage logs for last 90 days. Raised support request with cloud provider (ref #342 in infra PR comments).

Vendor reviews:
- VaultCorp (secrets-store) - questionnaire in progress.
  - Completed sections: encryption, key management, access controls.
  - Open: subprocessor list, SOC2 report copy, penetration test evidence.
  - Next: request SOC2 report copy and recent pentest; if redacted, get summary and remediation plan. Assigned: Priya. Deadline: 2026-03-05.
- LogStreamer (logging vendor) - initial risk low but need SLA confirmation for log retention > 1 year (policy asks for 13 months). Action: Samira to confirm retention policy and export capability.
- Third-party subprocessor register: build CSV with vendor name, data categories, region, contract clause present (yes/no). Template located in Confluence; need to adapt for Private deployments.

Policy TODOs / reminders:
- Data retention policy: update section on embeddings retention to include default TTL and opt-out for private deployments. Draft line: "Embeddings derived from customer data are retained for 30 days by default; customers on Dedicated or Private may request alternate retention via contract clause." Need legal review.
- Incident response runbook: add SOC2 evidence appendix mapping incidents -> notifications -> forensic artifacts. TODO: draft mapping and add sample logs.
- Vendor contract template: add explicit clause for "right to audit" for vendors handling customer data. Talk to legal.

Short-term daily checklist (today):
- [ ] Get signed attestation from SRE leads for access matrix (Noah)
- [x] Send VaultCorp questionnaire follow-up email (Priya) - done 2026-02-26
- [ ] Pull Okta export for Feb/Mar (Identity) - follow up
- [ ] Confirm LogStreamer retention capabilities (Samira)
- [ ] Add embeddings TTL text to data-retention draft and ping legal
- [ ] Attach prod rollback remediation note to change-management evidence

Meeting notes (2026-02-26 sync with audit team):
- Audit team wants evidence zipped and uploaded to shared S3 bucket with ephemeral access links.
- They suggested a minimal manifest CSV: artifact_type, owner, created_at, link, notes.
- Action: create manifest template and populate for access reviews + change mgmt.

Open questions / blockers:
- Can Dedicated customers request per-tenant KMS keys? (I think yes for Private; confirm with infra)
- How to securely share SOC2 vendor reports that are NDA-only? Legal suggests redacted copy + executive summary. Need process.
- Who owns retention policy for embeddings - product or infra? Assign to product-privacy for now.

Notes to self:
- Keep scratchpad lively - copy into formal evidence bundle once items confirmed.
- Use manifest template to speed uploads next audit.

References & quick links:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-SEC-1122 (access matrix), CONFLUENCE-RET-77 (data retention draft)
- Jira: JIRA-SOC2-58 (evidence collection tracker), JIRA-OKTA-243 (okta export request)
- GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342 (infra note about KMS rotation)

-- end of scratchpad
